whatItIs: Perceval is an open-source project in the photonics category. It is maintained by Quandela and primarily looks like a Python codebase. Perceval

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches photonics workflows in practice. whoItsFor: People exploring optical and photonic models of quantum computing, especially outside the usual gate-model framing.
whatYouCanBuild: Understand how photonic circuits, modes, and optical programs are represented.
Compare photonic workflows with more familiar circuit-model SDKs.

readmeExcerpt: Perceval Through a simple object-oriented python API, Perceval provides tools for building a circuit with linear optics components, defining single-photon sources and their error model, manipulating Fock states, running simulations, reproducing published experimental papers results, and experimenting with a new generation of quantum algorithms.
